nphi.with: National Institute of Health of Somalia; National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Rwanda Biomedical Centre; Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI); University of Zambia; IAVI Africa; Infectious Diseases Institute; University of Copenhagen; LSHTM; Amsterdam UMC; Charité; University of Oslo; Karolinska Institutet; University of Oxford; BNITM; Université Catholique de Bukavu
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence led scientifically by Uganda's national health research organisation, expanding clinical research and outbreak research capacity across East Africa; partners include the national public…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P99 – Strengthening biosafety and biosecurity capabilities in East and Central Africa
nphi.with: Expertise France; SCJS Europe; University of Liège; ISEM Institute
nphi.summary: RIVM leads the national biorisk assessment and biorisk-management work packages and co-leads dual-use research oversight in a One Health biosecurity project.

nphi.title: JUA-KIVU – Clade I mpox epidemiology, evolution and immunology in South Kivu
nphi.with: Rwanda Biomedical Centre; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burundi; Stansile Ltd (scientific lead); Université Catholique de Bukavu; Good Samaritan Foundation (KCMC); Technical University of Denmark; University of Castilla-La Mancha
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 study of the origin, spread and immune responses of clade Ib mpox in eastern DRC, involving the national public health institutes of Rwanda (RBC) and Burundi (INSP).

nphi.title: SINCEP-Africa – Institutional networks and capacity for epidemiological preparedness in Africa
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire; Ghana Health Service; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; PANDORA platform (France); Fundação Manhiça; Ifakara Health Institute; Makerere University; Université de Kinshasa; CNRST-IRSS; Universidad de Navarra; CTI Africa
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 coordination action turning INDEPTH community-based health surveillance sites into trial-ready sites for outbreaks, with Côte d'Ivoire's INSP hosting a new site.

nphi.title: ACT-PREP – Advancing clinical trials and epidemic preparedness research capacity in Africa
nphi.with: Africa CDC; Uganda Ministry of Health; Infectious Diseases Research Collaboration; Somali National University; Université de Kinshasa; MUHAS; Karolinska Institutet; BNITM; UGHE; UCAD; University of Juba
nphi.type: Network (Global Health EDCTP3 network of excellence)
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network building outbreak clinical-trial capacity embedded in national public health systems, working closely with Africa CDC.

nphi.title: AFRITRAC – African Training Network for Biostatistics, Epidemiology and Infectious Disease Modelling
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burundi; Africa CDC (partner); Université de Yaoundé I; USTTB Bamako; University of St Andrews; Makerere University; APHRC; University of Cape Coast; CERMEL; Mbarara University; Université Catholique de Bukavu
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 network training 35 early-career professionals through a harmonised master's programme and regional hub, with Tanzania's NIMR, Burundi's INSP and Africa CDC involved.

nphi.title: China CDC Ebola response expert deployments to Uganda and DRC (2026)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO; Uganda Incident Management Support Team; DRC health authorities
nphi.summary: At the invitation of Africa CDC and WHO, China CDC sent successive expert teams in 2026 to support Ebola surveillance, laboratory capacity and infection control in Uganda and the DRC.

nphi.title: EU-supported strengthening of national public health institutions in Guinea and DRC (ITM with Enabel)
nphi.with: National public health institutions of Guinea and DRC; Enabel
nphi.summary: ITM's Health Policy Unit works with Enabel on an EU-supported project to strengthen the capacity of national public health institutions in Guinea and DRC, with Burundi to be confirmed.

nphi.title: Team Europe Initiative: Strengthening Public Health Institutes in Africa (TEI PHI)
nphi.actor: European Commission with 12 EU Member States
nphi.with: Africa CDC; IANPHI; WHO; African NPHIs
nphi.summary: Launched March 2024 by the European Commission, 12 EU Member States and Africa CDC to strengthen African NPHIs' institutional capacity, regional collaboration and workforce, including linking European and African public health institutes;…

nphi.title: Ebola PREP-TBOX – Toolbox for Sudan ebolavirus outbreak preparedness
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) DRC; Uganda National Health Research Organisation; UVRI Clinical Research Program Initiative; Fondation Congolaise pour la Recherche Médicale (scientific lead); Hospital 12 de Octubre research foundation; CNRS; Fabentech
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project building detection, treatment and public health response tools for Sudan ebolavirus outbreaks, with DRC's INRB and Uganda's national health research organisation/UVRI.

nphi.title: EBO-PEP – Ebola Zaire post-exposure prophylaxis preparedness and efficacy evaluation
nphi.with: INSERM (coordinator); Agence Nationale de Sécurité Sanitaire (ANSS) Guinea; ALIMA; PANDEMIC platform; ISGlobal; Université de Bordeaux; PAC-CI; Université Gamal Abdel Nasser de Conakry; UCAD; MSF Belgium
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 trial led scientifically by DRC's INRB with Guinea's national health security agency ANSS, testing monoclonal antibodies as post-exposure prophylaxis for Ebola contacts and building rapid-trial infrastructure.

nphi.title: Emerging and Re-Emerging Pathogens Research Training Program in DRC (EREP-RTP-DRC)
nphi.with: Stellenbosch University; University of Antwerp and Institute of Tropical Medicine Antwerp; Boston University; UCLA; University of Pittsburgh; funded by US NIH (Fogarty D43)
nphi.summary: NIH-funded research training programme led by INRB with partners in South Africa, Belgium and the US, offering degree and short-term training and mentored research on Ebola, mpox, COVID-19 and drug-resistant TB.

nphi.title: ODIN – Strengthening environmental surveillance to advance public health action
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Finnish Institute for Health and Welfare (THL); Université de Kinshasa; CNRST-IRSS; Ghent University; VIB; University of Oxford; NORCE
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project piloting genomic wastewater and environmental surveillance of pathogens and AMR genes in Burkina Faso, DRC and Tanzania, with Finland's THL and Tanzania's NIMR as partners.

nphi.title: KDCA–IVI epidemiologist fellowship (MoU 2022)
nphi.actor: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
nphi.with: International Vaccine Institute (EPIC unit)
nphi.summary: After a 2022 MoU and letter of intent, two KDCA epidemiologists join IVI's EPIC unit every four months; 14 had completed it by Dec 2024, working on field projects in Ghana, DR Congo and Madagascar.

nphi.title: Osaka Metropolitan University – INRB overseas research base (J-GRID+)
nphi.actor: Osaka Metropolitan University (formerly Osaka City University)
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB)
nphi.summary: AMED-funded overseas infectious disease research base of Osaka Metropolitan University with the DRC's national biomedical research institute INRB.

nphi.title: JICA–NMIMR Third Country Training Programme for African national laboratories
nphi.with: Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research (NMIMR); national laboratory staff of West and Central African countries
nphi.summary: A JICA-funded laboratory training series hosted by Ghana's Noguchi Memorial Institute, launched after the West Africa Ebola outbreak, training national laboratory professionals from West, Central and Southern African countries in…

nphi.title: Africa CDC Central Africa Regional Collaborating Centre (Libreville)
nphi.with: Government of Gabon (host of Central Africa RCC, Libreville)
nphi.summary: Africa CDC operationalised its Central Africa RCC in Libreville in 2017, with Gabon providing offices, an emergency operations centre and biosafety labs to serve nine Central African states.

nphi.title: Southern African Centre for Infectious Disease Surveillance (SACIDS) One Health consortium
nphi.with: National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD), South Africa; Eduardo Mondlane University; University of Kinshasa; University of Zambia; MUHAS; Tanzania MoHSW; Royal Veterinary College; LSHTM
nphi.summary: One Health consortium formed in 2008 linking academic and research institutions, including South Africa's NICD, to strengthen detection and management of infectious disease risks in southern Africa.

nphi.title: CDC Democratic Republic of the Congo country office
nphi.with: Ministry of Health; Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP / national public health institute); DRC FETP
nphi.summary: CDC's DRC office (2002) supports the Ministry of Health and the national public health institute on Ebola and mpox response, the three-level FETP (925 trained), influenza surveillance (since 2006), lab accreditation, immunization,…

nphi.title: AFD support to INRB research and response capacity
nphi.with: Agence Française de Développement (AFD)
nphi.summary: During a July 2026 visit to Kinshasa, AFD announced continued support to INRB, including construction of a new administrative building to strengthen its research and outbreak-intervention capacity.

nphi.title: Africa CDC NPHI centres of excellence
nphi.with: Nine national public health institutes (incl. NPHIL Liberia)
nphi.summary: Africa CDC funded nine national public health institutes to act as regional hubs offering technical assistance, training and mentoring to peers, with plans to twin them with European NPHIs through ECDC.

nphi.title: CDC support to the DRC Ebola outbreak response in Bulape, Kasai (2025)
nphi.with: DRC Ministry of Public Health
nphi.summary: More than 100 CDC staff, both at headquarters and in the DRC office, supported the Ministry of Public Health's response to the 16th Ebola outbreak (September–December 2025). CDC deployed a team to Kinshasa and the outbreak zone and helped…

nphi.title: ODIN-Mpox – Wastewater and environmental surveillance for mpox in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.with: National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR) Tanzania; Université de Kinshasa (scientific lead); University of Helsinki; Ghent University; VIB; CNRST-IRSS; University of Oxford; NORCE
nphi.summary: Global Health EDCTP3 project applying genomic wastewater and environmental surveillance to track mpox in the DRC and neighbouring countries, with Tanzania's NIMR as a beneficiary.

nphi.title: CDC support to DRC on clade I mpox (lab testing, sequencing, vaccine research)
nphi.with: DRC Ministry of Health; Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) (co-authors/data)
nphi.summary: For about 15 years CDC has helped DRC with mpox lab testing and training, diagnostics, genomic sequencing, JYNNEOS vaccine research and health-worker training. In 2024 the US set up an interagency team to provide funding, technical help…

nphi.title: Côte d'Ivoire public health bulletin and Francophone bulletin exchange
nphi.actor: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Côte d'Ivoire
nphi.with: NPHIs of Burkina Faso, DRC and Mali; WAHO; US CDC; IANPHI; TEPHINET
nphi.summary: INSP Côte d'Ivoire launched its public health bulletin (BSP-CI) in April 2023 with CDC/IANPHI support. In August 2024 it hosted a Francophone peer exchange workshop in Abidjan on bulletins with Burkina Faso, DRC and Mali.

nphi.title: IDRC-funded One Health epidemics project in Guinea and DRC
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP, Guinea); Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB, DRC); CERFIG (Guinea); University of Ottawa
nphi.summary: IDRC awarded nearly CAD 5 million (2022) to a three-year project led by the University of Ottawa, with Guinea's INSP and DRC's INRB, to decentralize One Health platforms and strengthen surveillance and risk communication for emerging…

nphi.title: TB-COVID – COVID-19 impact on TB programmes in West and Central Africa
nphi.with: WHO Global TB Programme; WHO/TDR; WARN-TB/CARN-TB; HISP, University of Oslo (Norway)
nphi.summary: Built NTP capacity to monitor and mitigate COVID-19 disruption to TB services via a framework, DHIS2 package and preparedness plans.

nphi.title: BCHW – Corona Global – COVID-19 burden among health care workers
nphi.with: Nigeria Centre for Disease Control; National Veterinary Research Institute (Nigeria); Laboratoire d'Analyse Médicale Malagasy (Madagascar); CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); INRB (DR Congo); Friedrich-Loeffler-Institut (Germany)
nphi.summary: Multisite study of HCW infection, vaccine effectiveness and risk factors, with a One Health module.

nphi.title: PREP-EPID – Strengthening research and operational capacities for outbreaks and epidemics in sub-Saharan Africa
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Burkina Faso; Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB) DRC; Gamal Abdel Nasser University of Conakry; GRAS; CNRST-IRSS
nphi.summary: EDCTP2/Africa CDC consortium training epidemiologists and biostatisticians from francophone African countries, involving Burkina Faso's INSP and DRC's INRB.

nphi.title: Support to establish DRC's National Public Health Institute
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP), DRC; also IANPHI, Africa CDC, WHO, Jhpiego
nphi.summary: At the DRC government's request, US CDC supported the set-up of the national public health institute from 2018. This included a technical working group that drafted the roadmap, plans and organogram, leading to the institute's creation by…

nphi.title: JICA project for improvement of INRB facilities
nphi.with: Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA)
nphi.summary: Japanese-funded upgrade of INRB laboratory equipment and facilities in Kinshasa to develop pathogen identification capacity; environmental monitoring reports cover 2018–2019.

nphi.title: SATREPS: epidemiology of zoonotic virus infections in Africa (Zambia, DRC)
nphi.with: University of Zambia; Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB, DRC)
nphi.summary: Hokkaido University SATREPS project with the University of Zambia and DRC's INRB studying zoonotic virus infections such as Ebola and developing diagnostics.

nphi.title: ALERRT – African coaLition for Epidemic Research, Response and Training
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale (INRB); Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Institut Pasteur; Institut Pasteur de Dakar; Institut Pasteur de Côte d'Ivoire; Institut Pasteur de Bangui; Institut Pasteur de Madagascar; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; Bernhard-Nocht-Institut; ITM Antwerp; KNUST; ALIMA
nphi.summary: EDCTP2-funded network building clinical research capacity to respond rapidly to epidemics in sub-Saharan Africa. Partners include national biomedical/public health institutes (INRB, UNHRO) and the Institut Pasteur network.

nphi.title: Annual West and Central Africa surveillance and health information systems workshop (Dakar, 2020)
nphi.with: US CDC (Atlanta and Senegal offices); WHO; HISP West and Central Africa
nphi.summary: Fourth annual IANPHI–US CDC technical workshop (Dakar, March 2020) where seven Francophone African countries shared experience on surveillance data use, DHIS2 roll-out, One Health zoonoses assessment and community event-based surveillance.

nphi.title: PREPARE – Partnership for Building Resilience against Public Health Emergencies through Advanced Research and Education
nphi.with: INRB (DRC), ZNPHI (Zambia), NMIMR (Ghana), KEMRI (Kenya), Suez Canal University (Egypt) and other core laboratories
nphi.summary: JICA programme linking core infectious disease laboratories in Africa and Asia, including JICA-funded BSL-3 facilities at DRC's INRB, regional surveillance training at ZNPHI and long-term training run with Nagasaki and Hokkaido…

nphi.title: TRICE – Training on investigation and control of epidemics
nphi.with: Centre Muraz; CHU Sourô Sanou (Burkina Faso); CHU Bouaké; Université Alassane Ouattara; LANADA (Côte d'Ivoire); INRB; Kinshasa University Hospital (DR Congo); NICD; University of Pretoria (South Africa)
nphi.summary: Built outbreak investigation, hospital infection surveillance, AMR and VHF diagnostic capacity.

nphi.title: PPE – Partnership in postgraduate education
nphi.with: Centre Muraz (Burkina Faso); CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Kinshasa University Hospital (DR Congo); LAUTECH, NCDC, Obafemi Awolowo University, University of Ibadan (Nigeria); Naval Hospital Medical Center (Peru); Epidemiology Bureau DOH (Philippines); University of Pretoria (South Africa); Colombo Teaching Hospital Ragama (Sri Lanka); Central Laboratory (Sudan); Avicenna Tajik State Medical University (Tajikistan); Charles Nicolle Hospital (Tunisia)
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer postgraduate stays at RKI in lab diagnostics and epidemiology for partner-country scientists.

nphi.title: ARGOS – Antimicrobial resistance global surveillance
nphi.with: CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Centre Muraz; CHU Sourô Sanou (Burkina Faso)
nphi.summary: Installed blood culture diagnostics and sentinel AMR surveillance in African hospitals.

nphi.title: NML mobile laboratory deployment for the 2012 Ebola outbreak in DRC
nphi.actor: Public Health Agency of Canada – National Microbiology Laboratory
nphi.with: World Health Organization (requesting agency)
nphi.summary: At WHO's request, the Winnipeg National Microbiology Laboratory deployed a mobile laboratory team to the DRC in 2012 to provide rapid on-site Ebola diagnostic testing.
